findings.auditFinding: Silver publication trusts caller-owned season scope, season derivation, and undeclared source columns, permitting historical rows to be relabeled and post-outcome columns to enter the published object.
findings.currentExpectedFailureBehavior: At baseline 5ec6c9b production accepts each unsafe caller-controlled season or column condition, so the rejection assertions fail directly.
findings.requiredCorrectedBehavior: The server must own the authorized season set and season derivation, reconstruct consistent season evidence across every receipt and output, and reject every source column outside a canonical pre-outcome allowlist.

findings.auditFinding: Source identity can be self-minted or relationally inconsistent, while transform, semantic, family, ordering, generation, and source-authority relationships are incomplete or static.
findings.currentExpectedFailureBehavior: The source resolver, publisher, and emitted contracts accept forged or incomplete authority and produce mismatched lineage fields, causing every red assertion to fail on the production result.
findings.requiredCorrectedBehavior: Only a server-issued canonical source may enter Silver, and verification must reconstruct source, transform-code, semantic-member, ordering, generation, authorized-season, and base-feature authority from immutable receipts.
findings.affectedProductionBoundary: Silver source resolver, source issuer, transformation receipt, semantic contracts, feature-family lineage, and feature-set publication

findings.auditFinding: The Silver verifier validates outer child hashes but accepts coordinated re-addressing when embedded self-addresses or cross-child contract relationships are forged.
findings.currentExpectedFailureBehavior: The valid 14-child positive control passes; each of the fourteen coordinated mutation cases is accepted by the baseline verifier and therefore fails its production rejection assertion.
findings.requiredCorrectedBehavior: Verification must recompute embedded self-addresses and reconstruct every source, value, semantic, family, feature-set, transform, output, and publication-manifest relationship from canonical authority.

findings.auditFinding: Canonical eligibility ignores approvedForTraining=false, and direct persisted-run, estimator, V2 recompute, and V1 recompute paths can bypass a later dataset quarantine.
findings.currentExpectedFailureBehavior: The six required open boundaries accept not-approved or quarantined evidence and fail directly; already-closed listing, binding, execution, activation, active-read, comparison, and no-export controls pass.
findings.requiredCorrectedBehavior: Every catalog, binding, execution, activation, reload, recompute, direct run, direct artifact, active-read, comparison, and export boundary must re-evaluate canonical eligibility and fail closed after quarantine.
findings.affectedProductionBoundary: server.sports_cockpit.gen3_authority canonical eligibility and all persisted-evidence consumers

findings.auditFinding: Several Windows filesystem authorities inspect, resolve through, read, or mutate a junction before complete reparse containment is established.
findings.currentExpectedFailureBehavior: Five already-contained object, staging, registry, and lock boundaries pass; seven evidence, receipt, and quarantine boundaries perform or permit the unsafe operation and fail their rejection assertions.
findings.requiredCorrectedBehavior: Every existing ancestor, parent, directory, final object, child, receipt, quarantine source, and quarantine destination must be reparse-checked before exists, iteration, resolution, read, write, mkdir, rename, replace, or move.
findings.affectedProductionBoundary: Windows containment in Silver publication, Gen3 V2 evidence/receipt handling, registry locking, and incomplete-namespace quarantine

findings.auditFinding: The isolated-data guard misses common readers, blanket-allows OS temp, swallows installation and manifest failures, permits missing or invalid manifests, and overwrites collection evidence.
findings.currentExpectedFailureBehavior: All twelve required probes fail because the production guard or committed full-gate runner accepts the bypass, swallows the error, shares/loses the manifest, or lacks schema enforcement.
findings.requiredCorrectedBehavior: Every reader entry point must be guarded before ordinary I/O, roots must be narrowly authoritative, installation/write/schema failures must be fatal, and distinct collection/execution evidence must both be present and preserved.

findings.auditFinding: The committed analyzer does not enforce policy schema/version/selection, reverse collection-to-JUnit parity, exact allowed-to-actual skip equality, complete critical authority, or an independently bound category.
findings.currentExpectedFailureBehavior: Seven governance mutations false-pass and therefore fail the red assertions; the analyzer already rejects an exact reason change, so that immutable positive boundary passes.
findings.requiredCorrectedBehavior: The analyzer must validate exact policy identity and selection, enforce three-way collection/JUnit parity, require exact expected/actual skip equality, preserve all critical authorities, and bind both skip reason and category.
